rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on overhang) with no third-party involvement or theft is a straightforward property_damage claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports wind damage to back porch overhang with approximately four shingles blown off. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion or additional damage. Low-severity wind damage to residential structure.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
